name: Ozone probe
summary: Near-surface ozone from NASA's GEOS-CF model. Hover, touch or use the arrow keys: more ozone plays a higher note.
author: moran
description: Explore near-surface ozone by hover, touch or arrow keys: higher ozone plays a higher note, patchy areas sound brighter, east/west pans left/right. Play the timeline to hear it change over two weeks.
